correctness.rationale: Exact fan-cover radius <=3/4 verified by five rational-surd squared distances. Six vertices force three disjoint adjacent pairs for any radius <=3/4. On each matched disk a+b>=1 implies chord distance squared >=9/4+3(a-1/2)^2; each unmatched edge is inaccessible to the opposite matching disk because sqrt(3)>3/2, so total three edge constraints force sum(a+b)>=3. Combined with per-disk a+b<=1 this forces equality on every disk and uniquely pins its center by a length-3/2 diameter. Two hexagon-cycle perfect matchings give exactly two triples. Pure-standard-library exact arithmetic checks executed successfully; mathematical quantifiers follow from analytic monotonicity, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Continuous polygonal three-center approximation for a canonical regular hexagon is a natural practical and geometric invariant addressed numerically in published benchmarks. Proving a long-used upper construction genuinely optimal with a complete classification of ALL extremizers yields an exact calibration example with matching-based rigidity, rather than a parameter renaming or table recomputation. Distinguishes entire-region optimization from diameter-bounded point-set pigeonhole results.
